# Appeal ruling on the exclusion of an estimate

Appellant: ⟦PERSON|Kaelen Renn III⟧

Respondent: ⟦ORG|Plover Flint Restorations Ltd⟧ (the Respondent)

1. The appeal concerns the refusal to admit a repair estimate received shortly before the final hearing. The first instance decision treated the estimate as introducing a new head of loss. In fact, it addressed the same damaged mechanism described in the original pleading.

2. The appellant's full name, including the generational suffix, appears as ⟦PERSON|Kaelen Renn III⟧ on the signed instruction. The suffix forms part of the name and distinguishes the appellant from a relative mentioned in the correspondence. It is not a paragraph number or a professional title.

3. The respondent had already inspected the mechanism and obtained its own estimate. Admitting the additional document would therefore have required an opportunity to comment, but would not necessarily have required a new inspection or a lengthy adjournment.

4. The appeal is allowed to the limited extent that the estimate may be considered. The substantive valuation remains for the first instance decision-maker. We express no conclusion about whether the proposed replacement is proportionate to the damage proved.

5. The parties must provide short written observations within fourteen days. Each will bear its own costs of this appeal. Rule 7.4 governs any application to correct an accidental error in this ruling.

Issued on 5 December 2026.

Panel chair: ⟦PERSON|Evrin Lothick⟧.
